no_outcome_promised.note: No refund, compensation, disciplinary action or other outcome is promised or implied. It only says the complaint will be reviewed and answered.

no_liability_admitted.note: The apology covers how upset and hurt the customer feels, not the teller's conduct. It does not concede that the events happened or that the bank was at fault.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No mention of discrimination law, regulations or regulators, and no view on whether anything was unlawful.

no_invented_specifics.note: Only the standard 10-business-day timeframe is added. No invented procedures, policies or timelines.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the visit date and branch, the check deposit, the savings account question for her daughter, the teller laughing at her accent, the quoted remark, feeling humiliated, her eight years as a customer, and her request to know what the bank will do.

tone.note: The wording is warm and plain, but the reply is entirely in English. The customer wrote in Spanish, and her complaint is about being mocked for her accent and told to 'speak English.' An English-only reply is likely to read as dismissive or tone-deaf, and she may not fully understand it.

mode_respected.note: Every disputed event is framed as the customer's account ('You told us…'). It takes no position on the substance and refers only to 'a specialist team' without naming a department.

revision_instructions: Write the reply (subject and body) in Spanish, since the customer wrote in Spanish and her complaint concerns being mocked for her English. Alternatively, give the full reply in Spanish with the English version below it.

Keep all the current content when translating: the restatement framed as her account ('Usted nos indicó que…'), the sympathy statement that does not concede fault, the statement that a specialist team is reviewing her complaint (do not name a department), and the response timeframe of within 10 business days ('dentro de 10 días hábiles').
Do not add any commitment about outcomes, disciplinary action or investigation steps when translating.
